scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveling Jacob pauses on a rocky path as three radiant, winged figures approach him in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's encounter with the angels of God; their appearance and the setting are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands on a rocky hillside, gesturing toward a sunlit encampment in a broad valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays Jacob’s response and the camp; the verse does not describe the landscape or the camp’s appearance.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob raises a hand beside a rocky encampment as three messengers walk along a winding path toward reddish mountains.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob gestures as he speaks to three attentive travelers on a hillside road, with camels and a distant encampment in warm evening light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob giving the message; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a departing messenger while people tend oxen, a donkey, sheep and goats near a pastoral encampment.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the sending of the message and the household described in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob listens to two messengers on a rocky hillside; one gestures toward a large company approaching along a distant road.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of the messengers’ report and the approaching company; the verse does not describe their appearance or setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried Jacob gestures between two groups of people and livestock in a golden hill country, with sheep, cattle, and camels among them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob dividing his people and animals into two camps; the landscape and individual figures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A concerned man gestures toward a distant camp while speaking to people beside a nearer camp; riders approach in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the verse’s conditional danger and hope of escape as a moment of planning, not as an attack that has already happened.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels with clasped hands beside his staff on a rocky path overlooking sunlit hills and a distant settlement.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob praying and suggests the return he recalls; the landscape and setting are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler holding a wooden staff stands on a rocky rise above a winding river, looking toward two separate camps of tents, people, and livestock in a sunlit valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the speaker’s recollection of crossing the Jordan and his account of two camps together in one landscape.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man kneels in prayer near an encampment as a mother holds two children beside a tent; an empty road winds toward distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the speaker's prayer and fear; the verse expresses a feared attack rather than describing one taking place.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels on a sunlit shore, letting sand fall from his hand beside the sea.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative seashore scene pictures the verse’s comparison; the verse does not say the speaker was at the sea.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man selects folded goods by firelight beside a tent, with sheep and goats resting under a starry sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the overnight stay and preparation of a gift; the setting and goods are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Large flocks of goats and sheep spread across a sunlit, rocky landscape, with a bearded goat and curling-horned ram among the animals in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene suggests the abundance of animals named in the verse; it does not depict a count of each flock.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A camel and her young stand beside a herd of cows and bulls, with more camels and donkeys scattered across a sunlit valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene represents the kinds of animals named in the verse; it does not depict a count of every animal.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures along a winding path as servants lead separate groups of livestock through sunlit hills, with stretches of open path between the herds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the servants leading the herds ahead with space between them; the landscape and appearance of the people and animals are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to an attentive traveler beside a group of livestock on a sunlit path through the hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the instruction before the anticipated encounter; its setting and visual details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A servant gestures toward livestock while addressing a richly dressed traveler, with another man following on a distant path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the message the servant is instructed to deliver. The verse gives instructions rather than narrating this meeting; appearances and setting are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to attentive herdsmen on a rocky path, with livestock and more handlers stretching into a sunlit landscape behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the instruction described in the verse; the setting and figures are an artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands on a rocky path watching servants lead a caravan of livestock ahead through a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob following the present as it goes ahead of him; the landscape, livestock and appearance of the travelers are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits by a fire outside a tent at night, watching a torchlit procession with laden animals travel along a road under the moon.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the present going ahead while the man remains in camp; the appearance of the camp and procession is an artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: By lantern light and beneath a moonlit sky, a man leads women and children through a shallow, rocky stream, with a donkey among them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the nighttime crossing; the landscape, lantern, and appearance of the travelers are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward travelers leading laden donkeys through a shallow, rocky brook in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined crossing illustrates the verse; the landscape, travelers, animals, and belongings are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient garments wrestle on rocky ground as the sun rises over distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob and the man wrestling as day breaks; their appearances and the landscape are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient garments wrestle on rocky ground; one touches the other's hip as he grimaces, with trees, water and distant hills in warm light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the touch to Jacob's hip during the struggle; the setting and the figures' appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, a man grips another man’s arm on a rocky hillside as the second gestures toward the dawn over a river valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange at daybreak and the refusal to let go without a blessing; its landscape, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded traveler sits on a rocky hillside with one hand against his chest, looking toward an unseen person as golden light falls over a distant valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob answering the question about his name; the landscape, light, clothing, and gesture are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated Jacob looks up at a robed figure gesturing toward him among rocks, with warm light over distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the announcement of Jacob's new name; its setting and appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels among rocks and raises a hand toward a standing figure seen from behind, who extends a hand over him in blessing. A river and hills lie in warm light beyond them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses gesture and setting to suggest Jacob's question and the blessing; the verse does not specify these visual details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands among rocky hills with a hand over his heart, looking upward as warm sunlight illuminates a river valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays Jacob's awe and gratitude at Peniel; the landscape and his pose are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff and a hand on his hip walks along a rocky path as the sun rises over distant hills and a settlement.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the sunrise and the man limping as he passes Penuel; the landscape and details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sets aside a portion of meat on a pottery dish as a child watches; in the distance an older man walks with a staff and holds his hip.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the food practice in the verse with the touch to Jacob’s hip; its household setting and figures are artistic interpretation.
